description: An npm package published to npmjs.com through trusted publishing
oidcSteps: Check the npm trusted publisher (OIDC exchange)
notes: On npmjs.com, open each package, then Settings, then Trusted Publisher, choose GitHub Actions and enter the values above. Every publishable package needs its own record.
A package must already exist on npm before it can have a trusted publisher: publish a first version by hand if it is new.
Pushing a v* tag is the publish right: protect v* tags with a repository ruleset, or limit who can push tags.
